privacy.metaDescription: RADIANZ privacy policy: data collected via the site and contact form, purposes, retention, and GDPR rights.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: RADIANZ is committed to protecting the personal data of site visitors and people who contact us via the form.

dataController.title: Data controller
dataController.body: The data controller is RADIANZ. For any questions about your data, contact us via the form on the Contact page.

dataCollected.title: Data collected
dataCollected.body: We collect information you enter in the contact form: first name, last name, email, company, and message. Technical data (IP address, browser, pages visited) may be recorded for security and analytics.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.body: Your data is used to respond to requests, ensure commercial follow-up, improve the site, and guarantee its security. We do not sell your data to third parties.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.body: Contact requests are kept for the duration of commercial follow-up, then archived or deleted within three years of the last exchange, unless legally required otherwise.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object, and port your data. You may also file a complaint with your data protection authority.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: To exercise your rights or ask about this policy, use the Contact page form specifying the subject of your request.
